candidate.announceSeparator.note: Core joins the parts of a candidate announcement with this.

candidate.detailKeys.ja: 矢印キーで詳細を確認・PageUp / PageDownで詳細をスクロール
candidate.detailKeys.en: Arrow keys show details; PageUp / PageDown scroll the details

candidate.focusedSelect.ja: 操作対象。押すと候補を選択
candidate.focusedSelect.en: Current navigation target. Select this candidate

candidate.score.conditional100.ja: 100はこの分岐内の相対値です。子候補が一つでも100になり、正解を保証しません。
candidate.score.conditional100.en: 100 is relative to this branch. A sole child also gets 100; it does not guarantee a correct conversion.

candidate.score.explanation.ja: 同じ読み・消費範囲の取得候補を、同じ親から分かれる候補同士で比べた値です。非表示の候補も含みます。正解の確率ではありません。
candidate.score.explanation.en: These values compare returned candidates with the same reading and consumed input, conditional on their parent. Hidden candidates count too. They are not probabilities of correctness.

candidate.score.roundedZero.ja: 0は丸めた相対値です。この候補が不可能という意味ではありません。
candidate.score.roundedZero.en: 0 is a rounded relative value. It does not mean this candidate is impossible.

candidate.score.unavailable.ja: 未評価: 同じ読み・消費範囲で比較できる評価がありません。
candidate.score.unavailable.en: Not evaluated: no comparable evaluation for the same reading and consumed input.

candidate.selectHint.en: Select a candidate, then press Enter to confirm
